smells.description: Cycle Library.Desktop -> Library.Desktop.Pages -> Library.Desktop: AppHost creates SearchPage, LoansPage, AccountPage and ListenPage, and every page uses INavigator from Library.Desktop.

Cycle Library.Desktop -> Library.Desktop.Pages -> Library.Desktop.Media -> Library.Desktop, distinct from the two-component cycle: AppHost creates ListenPage, ListenPage uses AudiobookPlayer, and AudiobookPlayer uses the PlaybackState enum declared in Library.Desktop.
Library.Desktop (I = 1/3: depends on Pages, used by Pages and Media) depends on the less stable Library.Desktop.Pages (I = 2/3: depends on Library.Desktop and Media, used by Library.Desktop).

Library.Desktop.Pages realizes four features whose classes do not use each other: search [SearchPage], loans [LoansPage], account [AccountPage] and audiobook listening [ListenPage]. Their only shared dependency, INavigator, lies outside this component.

The caching concern (a time-limited GetOrAdd lookup cache) is realized separately in Library.Core.Catalog [CatalogCache] and Library.Core.Members [MemberCache], each of which is also responsible for its own concern (book catalog, member registry).
Library.Tests contains 32 classes in a single component: the test classes for every part of the system plus their builders, fakes and helpers. A test project is analysed like any other project.

Library.Tests realizes ten independent groups of classes that do not use each other: catalog [BookBuilder, BookCatalogTests, BookCatalogSearchTests, CatalogCacheTests], members [MemberBuilder, MemberRegistryTests, MemberCacheTests], loans [FixedClock, LoanScenario, LoanServiceTests, LoanPolicyTests, LateFeeCalculatorTests], pages [RecordingNavigator, SearchPageTests, LoansPageTests, AccountPageTests, ListenPageTests], app host [AppHostTests], audiobook player [SilentAudioFile, AudiobookPlayerTests], smoke [StartupSmokeTests], JSON [JsonAssert, BookJsonTests, MemberJsonTests, LoanJsonTests], load [LoadTestRunner, CatalogLoadTests, MemberLoadTests] and fixture files [TestDataPaths, SampleCatalogFile, SampleMembersFile, FixtureFilesTests].
